drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 65-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.87, creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 12, pao2 56, platelets 263, sodium 138, wbc 8.4; vitals dbp 76-80, heart_rate 84-90, map 94-98, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-32, sbp 130-136, spo2 86-94, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 12, platelets 262, sodium 138, wbc 8.8; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 85-88, map 94-99, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-26, sbp 129-134, spo2 93-95, temp 36.7-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Not in respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 65-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Not in respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
